preamble: Palatalization of the voiced alveolar fricative [z] to [zʲ]: the tongue body is raised toward the hard palate during the consonant, typically before front vowels or a palatal glide. It is phonemic in Russian and Bulgarian and automatic before front vowels in Lithuanian.

examples.note: 'zebra'; automatic palatalization before a front vowel
'I gape'; palatalized consonant before a back vowel

sources: Urbanavičienė, J. (2019). Palatalization of Consonants in Standard Lithuanian from the Viewpoint of Acoustic Phonetics. Buletin Științific, Seria A, Fascicula Filologie 28, 103–138. https://doi.org/10.37193/bsff.2019.28.09

Jones, D., & Ward, D. (1969). The Phonetics of Russian. Cambridge University Press.
